countries.codeLicense: Public domain (explicit declaration in source file)
countries.nameSource: Unicode CLDR 48.0 via ICU 78.3, Node.js v24.22.1 Intl.DisplayNames
countries.coordinates: Not bundled; null is intentional and does not imply [0, 0].

rules.scope: Ordinary passport, tourism, single entry, direct arrival, no transit. No residence-permit alternatives, rolling-window limits or conditions of admissibility.
rules.status: Real source downloaded and Git blob verified. Most pairs have no individual verification; do not imply current official coverage. Dates were copied only when supplied.

geometry.status: Downloaded and normalized. Natural Earth de facto boundaries; small territories may have no polygon. Two unassigned-code features omitted, no substitute borders invented.

candidates.notes: Only MCP https://mcp.doineedvisa.to allows anonymous access, limited to 20 calls/day/network identifier. REST https://api.doineedvisa.to requires a key obtained by email even on its 300 requests/month free tier. MCP is not a drop-in REST feed and is not activated. Data derives from imorte/passport-index-data plus curated official-source verification.

excluded.reason: October 2026 hosted service requires a key and human signup; terms prohibit offline/bulk dataset redistribution. Use CLDR instead.
Free sandbox is 100 requests/month; production is paid. Does not satisfy fully free production use.

refresh.mode: Explicit user action; anonymous HTTPS public static JSON; no user travel data sent
refresh.checkedAtPolicy: Only row verified; never download or compile time

officialSupplements.scope: Government snapshots merged independently over community; contradictory government rows remain unknown
